senses.definition: A mathematical approximation to the importance of a particular word in a given piece of text.
senses.example: The relevance of a document to a given search query can be guessed using the TF-IDF of each word they have in common.

senses.definition: Implies that an occurrence or event is highly unlikely.
TFT LCD, active matrix LCD using thin-film transistors.
representative of the sound of spitting
senses.example: "Business is business, but this man, captain, he make me very sick. Tfui!"
